R116.note: Per-member containment check (resolve + is_relative_to) before extractall correctly closes traversal for Python 3.11 without filter='data'; no unintended behavior change.

R117.note: Sets jdk.lang.Process.allowAmbiguousCommands, a JDK system property with no documented existence or effect; no actual escaping/validation of reportName is added, so the cmd.exe batch re-entry injection remains open (effectively a no-op fix).

R118.note: Strict allowlist (IP via net.ParseIP, else alnum/dot/hyphen) fully blocks shell metacharacters before the cmd.exe /C sink; IPv6 handled via the ParseIP branch so no legitimate target is rejected.

R119.note: Replaces raw-socket SMTP with Jakarta Mail Transport.send() plus strict InternetAddress parsing, which rejects CR/LF and closes the header/command injection; subject/body content preserved.

R120.note: Build FAILS (HttpHeaders.X_CONTENT_TYPE_OPTIONS is not a real Spring constant), so the whole controller fails to compile, silently breaking legitimate PNG/JPEG retrieval too; not disclosed in the write-up.

R121.note: Eliminates the shell entirely (separate ping/nslookup exec.Command calls) plus a comprehensive allowlist including IPv6 characters; preserves the original && short-circuit and error/output semantics.

R122.note: exec.Command('convert', inputPath, ...) removes the shell but still passes inputPath/outputPath as bare arguments, so a value starting with '-' can still be read as an ImageMagick flag (argument injection) - closes shell-metacharacter injection but not this related gap.

R123.note: Rejects rooted paths and '..' up front, then re-verifies via GetFullPath+StartsWith against the canonicalized root; matches the endpoint's stated intent of serving only files under _reportsRoot.

R124.note: redis-py hset() with a mapping correctly closes the RESP command-injection vector, but the function silently drops the return value (original returned the raw socket response bytes; fixed version returns None) without mentioning it.

R125.note: resolve-then-normalize plus Path.startsWith (component-aware, immune to the sibling-prefix bug) correctly rejects absolute and '..'-based escapes before the read; the explanation's claim that resolve() treats a String argument as always relative is factually wrong, but the code's containment check is correct regardless.

R126.note: Allowlist map limits the executable to a fixed small set of diagnostic tools, matching the handler's own stated intent ('one of a handful of network diagnostic utilities'); no legitimate tool use lost.

R127.note: Adds the separator to the prefix check (plus an exact-match branch), correctly rejecting sibling directories like uploads-backup while still allowing all genuine uploadsDir contents.

R128.note: Moves the tainted uid value into the parameterized filterArgs array ({0}), using JNDI's built-in RFC4515 escaping instead of string concatenation; filter semantics preserved.
